features.title: Player projections
features.claim: LineStar describes per-athlete DFS projections as an expected median outcome.
features.plan: Independent recency-weighted mean of synthetic historical fantasy points. This is not a reconstruction of the vendor model.
features.caveat: A mean is not a median; no measured accuracy parity.

features.title: Consensus projections
features.claim: LineStar describes a weighted average of industry projections.
features.plan: Blend only independently built or explicitly licensed forecasts after out-of-sample weight selection.
features.caveat: Contributors, weights, and reuse rights are not established.

features.title: Changing conditions & expert review
features.claim: The guide describes updates for weather, lineup changes, and news, with sport-specific expert review of anomalous projections.
features.plan: Fixture quality checks fail closed for stale or invalid data; no automatic human override.
features.caveat: Autonomous operation cannot silently reproduce the vendor’s expert judgment.

features.title: Editable projections
features.claim: Users can replace a player projection.
features.plan: Version and audit overrides; defaults must not require manual entry.
features.caveat: Not implemented in the public demo; no UI suggests a user override is a trained model.

features.title: Projection CSV import / export
features.claim: The guide describes CSV export and import requiring column mapping and outlier-name resolution.
features.plan: Export our synthetic projections and lineups in a project-specific CSV format.
features.caveat: Import and operator-compatible upload formats are not implemented. Automatic name matching was overstated in the old repo.

features.title: Sorting, filtering & value
features.claim: The guide documents slate, game, team and position filters and projected points per $1,000 in salary.
features.plan: Projection lab supports position filtering and sorting by points, value, and salary.
features.caveat: Salary is synthetic. Value is not expected return.

features.title: Performance history
features.claim: The app listing describes graphs comparing recent performance with projections.
features.plan: Display a deterministic walk-forward fixture evaluation with timestamps and error metrics.
features.caveat: Synthetic error metrics test software, not real predictive performance.

features.title: Lineup optimization
features.claim: The guide describes using projections with platform-specific salaries, positions, and contest rules.
features.plan: Exact small-pool search maximizes summed independent means under the demo roster constraints.
features.caveat: Demo roster is a project specification, not an audited operator integration. Patents still require counsel.

features.title: Lock / exclude players
features.claim: The guide documents locking chosen players and excluding unwanted players.
features.plan: Library enforces explicit slot locks and excluded IDs; late-swap scenario exercises slot preservation.
features.caveat: Library controls are tested; the UI presents fixed scenarios rather than every control.

features.title: Multiple lineups & export
features.claim: The guide advertises sets of 150+ lineups and export to supported operators.
features.plan: Generate up to three distinct fixture lineups, export project CSV.
features.caveat: Small-pool prototype is not a 150-lineup production solver or an operator submission tool.

features.title: Stack Finder
features.claim: The guide describes ranked potential stacks that users can select for optimization.
features.plan: An optional same-team QB + WR/TE constraint is implemented.
features.caveat: A stack constraint is not a fitted joint-outcome model or a profit guarantee.

features.title: Exposure & budget controls
features.claim: The pricing page advertises exposures and budget management.
features.plan: Library enforces salary limits and requested-set maximum exposure counts, rejecting incomplete portfolios.
features.caveat: Greedy sequential lineup selection is not a globally optimal portfolio. Exact vendor cap semantics not inspected.

features.title: Late swap & set re-optimization
features.claim: The guide separates individual replacement selection from bulk set re-optimization, and says operator entries must also be updated.
features.plan: Freeze started-game players in their exact slots and exclude newly locked additions.
features.caveat: No operator submission. Eligibility depends on contest rules and trustworthy lock times.

features.title: Projected ownership
features.claim: LineStar describes estimating the share of fantasy teams rostering a player using performance, matchups, injuries and salary.
features.plan: Train on licensed, contest-specific realized ownership with temporal holdouts.
features.caveat: No ownership numbers are fabricated. Training set and calibration are unknown.

features.title: Perfect Lineups
features.claim: The guide describes hindsight salary-and-position-constrained optimal lineups and advertises a free historical view.
features.plan: Compute a hindsight upper bound from licensed settled results, separately from predictive backtests.
features.caveat: Do not use the hindsight optimum as an achievable historical strategy.

features.title: Salary comparison
features.claim: Public navigation lists a DraftKings-versus-FanDuel salary comparison.
features.plan: Join licensed salaries by canonical ID, accounting for different budgets and scoring.
features.caveat: A link does not prove cross-platform field quality or access.

features.title: Salary changes
features.claim: Public navigation lists daily salary moves.
features.plan: Compare versioned snapshots within a consistent provider and contest type.
features.caveat: Do not mix differently scoped slates.

features.title: Touchdown report

features.plan: Model touchdown counts / probabilities from role and opportunity data after calibration.
features.caveat: No extension to college or Canadian football is established.

features.title: Snap counts

features.plan: Derive role shares from licensed participation data with availability timestamps.
features.caveat: Data publication schedules must be checked, not assumed live.

features.title: Red-zone usage

features.caveat: A roster or depth chart is not a confirmed starting lineup.

features.title: Live scoring

features.plan: Reconcile authorized live events with versioned scoring and corrections.
features.caveat: Static Pages has no continuously running feed backend.

features.title: Projection update log

features.plan: Publish model version, input timestamps and reason codes for every recomputation.
features.caveat: A menu description does not identify triggers or latency.

features.title: News & strategy articles
features.claim: The navigation lists player news and strategy; pricing describes expert, beat-reporter and team sources.
features.plan: License news inputs; link to originals rather than republishing reporting.
features.caveat: No supplier, social-scraping rights, or measured sentiment edge established.

features.title: Community chat
features.claim: The public documentation index describes real-time conversation with DFS players and experts.
features.plan: A separate moderated discussion feature could be built; no data is copied.
features.caveat: Not equivalent to FanSense sentiment or expert editorial coverage.

features.title: Social sentiment / FanSense
features.claim: The app listing describes a view of how other users feel about an athlete.
features.plan: Any future sentiment feature must collect first-party consented feedback.
features.caveat: Community opinions are not ground-truth ownership and cannot be recreated without a community.

features.title: Weather & player alerts
features.claim: The app listing advertises weather alerts, contextual icons and critical game/player push notifications.
features.plan: Generate rule-based alerts from authorized status / weather data; keep delivery separate from the model.
features.caveat: No response-time guarantee. Native push is not in this static prototype.

features.title: Mobile / desktop continuity
features.claim: The feature guide says lineups sync between the same account’s mobile and desktop clients.
features.plan: The site is responsive; future account-backed state sync requires a backend.
features.caveat: Responsive design does not implement native apps or cloud synchronization.

features.title: Advanced group / bring-back controls
features.claim: The old repository asserted exact group-count and bring-back controls; these details were not confirmed in the reviewed evidence.
features.plan: Treat generic group constraints and opponent bring-backs as our own proposed requirements, not verified vendor features.
features.caveat: Keep unverified until a permitted primary description supports each control.

features.title: Cash / tournament strategy settings
features.claim: The guide describes higher-floor cash-game preferences and higher-ceiling tournament preferences.
features.plan: Evaluate full outcome distributions and contest payouts; do not equate a heuristic score with expected profit.
features.caveat: The old projection × (1 − ownership) objective had no validation.

findings.title: 13 labels, not 13 proven live feeds
findings.claim: The public sport switcher lists 13 labels; the pricing comparison groups coverage into 12 sports. Treat these as different groupings, not evidence that every sport has every tool.

findings.title: An advertised factor count is not an open model
findings.claim: LineStar describes over 100 variables per athlete. The reviewed materials do not establish a complete factor list, coefficients, training procedure, supplier roster, or measured accuracy.

findings.title: Web offer: $39.99 monthly / $239.99 annual
findings.claim: These amounts appear on the public web pricing page. They are a dated observation of advertised pricing, not a checkout quote.

findings.title: US app description: $269.99 annual
findings.claim: The DraftKings app description advertises $12.99 weekly, $39.99 monthly with a 3-day trial, and $269.99 annually. The annual amount differs from the web offer; the cause is unverified.

findings.title: Paid inclusion is not proof of exclusive access
findings.claim: Premium inclusion is described, but every individual access boundary was not tested. Perfect Lineups explicitly advertises a free historical view. No account or paid data was used.

findings.title: Do not harvest or imitate protected outputs
findings.claim: The published terms restrict automated access, reverse engineering, AI/ML ingestion and competitive use. Keep LineStar outputs out of training, validation and redistribution; obtain a written license or qualified legal review before expanding this research.

findings.title: Four patent numbers are vendor-listed
findings.claim: The documentation lists US 9,751,010; 9,744,450; 10,478,721; and 11,660,533. This review does not establish current ownership, enforceability, claim scope, or freedom to operate. Independent implementation alone is not legal clearance.

findings.title: “Self-healing” does not establish auto-retraining
findings.claim: The projection guide describes rechecking variables and expert intervention. It does not document a reproducible nightly retraining algorithm in the material reviewed.

findings.title: Projection edge is not monetary expected value
findings.claim: The Props AI guide defines Edge % as a percentage difference from a line. Our EV calculator separately needs a win probability, push probability and payout; a positive projection difference alone is insufficient.

findings.title: Alternative vendors are candidates, not LineStar suppliers
findings.claim: NWS, nflverse, The Odds API and SportsDataIO have relevant public documentation. Nothing in the reviewed evidence identifies them as LineStar suppliers or establishes matching coverage, latency, or data rights.

inputs.need: Time-stamped game stats; canonical player/team IDs; corrections; playing time and role.

inputs.automation: Historical NFL is the proposed first integration. No real-data adapter is enabled.
inputs.gate: Audit upstream rights, season coverage, duplicates, corrections, and publication time. Public code is not a data license.

inputs.title: Minutes, snaps, opportunities & matchups
inputs.need: Pre-lock role estimates; pace / possessions; snap and red-zone opportunities; opponents and venue.
inputs.vendor: The public tools describe snaps, red-zone usage, NBA usage scenarios and matchups.
inputs.automation: Compute sport-specific derived features only after approved ingestion.
inputs.gate: nflverse participation has end-of-season availability. Do not leak it into in-season historical predictions.

inputs.title: Injury & confirmed-lineup events
inputs.need: Event time, publication time, participation status, source, starting status, and confidence.
inputs.vendor: LineStar describes injury-related updates and a confirmed-lineup dashboard.
inputs.automation: Blocked pending a reliable rights-approved current-season feed.
inputs.gate: Depth charts, rosters and news are not interchangeable with confirmed lineups; stale status blocks publication.

inputs.title: DFS salaries, eligibility & contest rules
inputs.need: Operator slate ID, player ID, roster position, salary, lock time, scoring version and cancellations.
inputs.vendor: The optimizer guide describes salaries, positions and platform constraints.
inputs.automation: Fixture-only today; no lobby scraping or user-upload dependency.
inputs.gate: Secure automated licensed salary access; confirm operator rules and redistribution rights. Library rules are not official eligibility.

inputs.title: Game odds & prop markets
inputs.need: Book, market, side, line, odds format, timestamp, settlement rules and archival snapshots.
inputs.vendor: Pricing mentions totals / implied team points; Props AI describes line collection.
inputs.automation: Blocked until API credentials and required market entitlements exist.
inputs.gate: API keys stay server-side. Coverage, rate limits and historical rights need account-level verification; no free-parity assumption.

inputs.title: Weather & venue context
inputs.need: Coordinates, roof state, issued-at forecast, valid-at time, temperature, wind and precipitation.
inputs.vendor: Vendor documentation lists weather among projection inputs.
inputs.automation: NWS is a documented independent candidate; no stadium mapping or live forecast adapter yet.
inputs.gate: Archive forecasts available before lock, not future observations. Open-Meteo hosted free API is non-commercial only.

inputs.title: Ownership & contest population
inputs.need: Realized player ownership tied to contest type, field size, slate, entry limits and lock time.
inputs.vendor: LineStar describes a predictive ownership model with performance / matchup / injury / salary inputs.
inputs.automation: No training labels secured; no fabricated proxy percentages.
inputs.gate: Vendor projected ownership is not ground truth. Obtain authorized realized contest observations and define the target population.

inputs.title: News, sentiment & consensus
inputs.need: Licensed text or metadata, publication timestamps, consented feedback, and authorized forecasts.
inputs.vendor: Vendor pages describe reporting, community sentiment and aggregated projections.
inputs.automation: Blocked. No source with suitable rights has been established for this project.
inputs.gate: No scraping competitor projections or beat-writer posts, and no assumption of positive predictive benefit.

inputs.title: Live events & settlement
inputs.need: Event sequence IDs, source timestamps, corrections, sport rules, finalized outcomes and audit log.
inputs.vendor: Navigation advertises live scoring; terms warn of possible delays and interruptions.
inputs.automation: Requires a backend / event queue beyond static hosting.
inputs.gate: Measure actual end-to-end latency. Never imply a free feed is always minutes slower or that any paid feed is infallible.

sports.gate: Licensed slate / injury inputs and time-safe history remain missing.

flags.title: Rights and patent clearance
flags.detail: Published terms restrict the requested reverse-engineering / competitive use. No authorization to harvest paid data or use outputs for model development was obtained.
flags.action: Keep vendor-data ingestion disabled. Obtain qualified counsel / appropriate written permissions before expanding beyond this public-description review.

flags.title: No measured quality parity
flags.detail: No real sports dataset, licensed comparator, or held-out sports accuracy measurement is delivered. The demo is entirely synthetic.
flags.action: Start an independently sourced, point-in-time NFL pilot and define evaluation before tuning. Never market parity until measured under an authorized comparison protocol.

flags.title: Paid access was overstated
flags.detail: The old repo asserted specific paid-only boundaries, including historical Perfect Lineup archives beyond a preview, without per-feature evidence.
flags.action: Use per-feature access status; the guide explicitly describes free historical viewing, with current depth still unknown.

flags.title: Pricing and trial discrepancy
flags.detail: Web annual pricing is $239.99; the US DK app description says $269.99 annually and a 3-day monthly trial.
flags.action: Treat prices as channel-specific dated observations. Do not assert one universal annual price or trial.

flags.title: A fully autonomous replica is not established
flags.detail: The projection guide documents human expert review; late-swap guidance requires user/operator actions.
flags.action: Our pipeline quarantines anomalies and never silently guesses or submits entries.

flags.title: Unknown hidden methods and suppliers
flags.detail: No full 100-factor list, learned weights, complete feeds or current service-level targets were established.
flags.action: Label only broad documented inputs; remove guessed supplier identities and performance claims.

flags.title: As-of leakage and stale data
flags.detail: Historical corrections, late publication and post-season data can make a backtest look better than live use.
flags.action: Store event time and availability time; reject unknown/stale status. Participation data is an explicit availability warning.

flags.title: Source code licenses are not data rights
flags.detail: Community API clients and public tables do not establish bulk retrieval or redistribution rights.
flags.action: Audit licenses dataset-by-dataset; do not use undocumented ESPN endpoints or Sports Reference scrapers as verified official APIs.

flags.title: Sport labels and tool scope
flags.detail: 13 menu labels differ from the 12-sport marketing grouping. Several old claims extended NFL/NBA tools to other leagues.
flags.action: Keep observed labels and explicit scope. Treat active slates and CSGO/CS2 mapping as unverified.

flags.title: EV and tournament objectives were incorrect
flags.detail: The old plan used mean-versus-line gaps as +EV and projection × (1 − ownership) as a tournament objective without validation.
flags.action: Use calibrated outcome probabilities, payouts, push/void rules, joint distributions and fees; the demo only verifies arithmetic.

flags.title: Hosted weather API has restrictions
flags.detail: Open-Meteo’s free hosted API is non-commercial and rate-limited.
flags.action: Choose a permitted plan/source before commercial use; keep forecast issue times.

flags.title: Static hosting is not a live feed service
flags.detail: GitHub Pages hosts static assets. No server-side secret storage, low-latency streaming or sports backend is delivered.
flags.action: Use Pages for documentation / demo. Add an authorized backend with freshness monitoring before live projections.

flags.title: Document and link quality
flags.detail: The review encountered soft-404 provider URLs, broken embedded videos, old terms text alongside numbered terms, and dated documentation. In this sandbox, direct Node rechecks of six allowlisted references failed at the network layer; separate public-text research retrieval succeeded.
flags.action: Use the successful canonical source links and the separate availability report. A network failure does not establish that a source is down, and reachability is not semantic verification. Keep observation and recheck dates separate.

flags.title: Pages administration unavailable
flags.detail: The GitHub integration returned HTTP 403 when asked to switch Pages from main:/ to main:/docs.
flags.action: Generated root and docs entrypoints support the existing main:/ configuration; no settings change is required for this release.

roadmap.title: Resolve rights and define a single-sport contract
tasks: Review vendor restrictions and patent claims with qualified counsel; do not assume independent code grants clearance.
Select NFL as a proposed pilot and obtain automated salary / eligibility / status feed rights.
Create a dataset-specific rights manifest including storage, derived-use and redistribution permissions.
roadmap.done: Documented rights for every required field, approved endpoints, and a negative test proving unauthorized sources cannot be ingested.

roadmap.title: Build authorized ingestion, IDs and quality gates
tasks: Use stable athlete / team / slate IDs and store event time, available-at time, source, license, schema and payload hash.
Add retry/backoff, bounded downloads, rate limits, timezone handling, duplicate checks and correction history.
Quarantine missing, conflicting, stale or out-of-range critical inputs; never substitute synthetic data into a live output.
roadmap.done: Replayable licensed historical snapshots plus tests for renamed players, trades, postponements, partial feeds and late scratches.

roadmap.title: Measure a real baseline before adding complexity
tasks: Freeze train/validation/test dates; fit role × rate models only on information available before the prediction cutoff.
Report MAE / RMSE for point means, quantile loss / interval coverage for ranges, calibration / log loss for prop probabilities.
Compare to naïve historical baselines by sport, position and news regime; report sample sizes and uncertainty.
Only promote a model after a preregistered improvement criterion on held-out data; retain rollback artifacts.
roadmap.done: Reproducible real-data evaluation, no leakage, versioned scoring including nonlinear bonuses, and no profitability or vendor-parity claims without evidence.

roadmap.title: Production optimizer and contest integrations
tasks: Replace bounded enumeration with an audited scalable solver when needed; version each operator’s exact roster and scoring rules.
Add explicit group and bring-back rules, minimum exposure feasibility and portfolio simulation.
Verify locked slots, canceled / early-start games, ties, rounding, CSV formats and operator permissions without automatic contest submission.
roadmap.done: Independent solver oracle tests, feasibility reports and operator-rule fixtures. Any legal clearance remains separate from solver correctness.

roadmap.title: Ownership and props only with suitable targets
roadmap.status: Blocked on labels and market rights
tasks: License contest-specific ownership labels; fit bounded / calibrated predictions without treating vendor projections as truth.
Archive authorized lines at decision time; model pushes, voids, fees and correlated multi-leg payouts.
Keep raw projection gaps, probabilities and monetary EV as separate displayed quantities.
roadmap.done: Time-split calibration reports with explicit populations, sample sizes and entitlement checks.

roadmap.title: Expand coverage and operational delivery
tasks: Validate each sport separately; do not assume NFL quality transfers to NBA, MLB, college sports or esports.
Add a backend, server-side secret manager, status monitoring and an incident / stale-data publication policy.
Revisit public feature descriptions only under a permitted review process; preserve dates and unresolved discrepancies.
roadmap.done: Rights-approved coverage matrix and measured reliability targets, not a blanket “all sports / no manual work” promise.
